dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Butch is the fiercest and strongest of all the cats here. The ginger one, and it's a she by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: I have names for all the cats here. Look, that's Jen-Jen, and there's Ogre Face and Cinnamon Bun...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: They come over when I call them now... Achoo!
